title: Velvety Rich German Pork Stew
description: A hearty and comforting German stew featuring pork, Shaoxing wine, and a rich beurre-monte sauce, perfect for a cold winter's night or as a hangover cure. This nut-free dish is sure to become a favorite.
instructions: Heat the beurre-monte in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the pork cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the Shaoxing wine and cook until the liquid is almost completely evaporated, about 2 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes, chicken broth, salt, and pepper, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes, or until the pork and vegetables are tender.
Stir in the heavy cream and continue to simmer for an additional 10 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
